# Airbnb-Inspired Flutter UI Skill

Use this skill for Cratewise UI work.

## Design direction

The UI should feel:

- Clean
- Premium
- Friendly
- Fast
- Minimal
- Collector-focused

## Use inspiration from

- Card-based layouts
- Strong spacing
- Clear typography
- Friendly onboarding
- Simple forms
- Clean filters
- Useful empty states

## Do not use

- Airbnb logos
- Airbnb name in app branding
- Airbnb brand colors as the main identity
- Airbnb-specific illustrations
- Exact copies of Airbnb screens

## Flutter rules

- Support light mode.
- Support dark mode.
- Use responsive layouts.
- Use large cover art where useful.
- Use clear loading, empty, and error states.
- Keep components reusable.

## Done criteria

- UI works on Android.
- UI works on iOS.
- UI works on iPadOS.
- UI has loading state.
- UI has empty state.
- UI has error state.
- UI does not copy Airbnb branding.
